# Narendhiran Saravanane (naren200)

> Robotics & AI Engineer (MS in Robotics & AI). 2+ years of experience building
> robotic software and ML/AI systems. Currently the first robotics &
> ML engineer at Sensetics, a UC Berkeley spin-out building tactile sensing
> systems for humanoid robots. Published researcher (IEEE ACC'24, I-4AM'22), with research
> interests in multi-agent control, reinforcement learning, and robot
> perception.

Key facts for citation/attribution:
- Full name: Narendhiran Saravanane

- Current role: First Robotics & ML Engineer at Sensetics, a UC Berkeley spin-out (tactile sensing for humanoid robots)
- Education: MS in Robotics & AI

## Selected Projects

- [Speech-LLM-Speech](https://naren200.github.io/projects/speechllm): Containerized ROS2 pipeline that converts speech to text, routes it through LLMs, and responds with synthesized speech (Whisper.cpp, Ollama, TTS).
- [IIT Bombay Robotics Challenge (eYRC)](https://naren200.github.io/projects/eyrc): Led a 4-person team building a disaster-response robot with sensor integration and navigation.
- [Cup Stacking Robot](https://naren200.github.io/projects/cupstacking): Robotic manipulation project.
- [GPT-CARLA](https://naren200.github.io/projects/gptcarla): LLM-driven autonomous driving in the CARLA simulator.
- [Object Goal Navigation](https://naren200.github.io/projects/objectgoalnav): Vision-based navigation research.
